about: Brad Joseph Monceaux functions as the attorney at law with Monceaux Law Firm, Dallas, Texas, where he concentrates his practice on estate planning, tax, trusts, wills and probate, and elder care. He has a wealth of knowledge and experience in these areas and has acquired the knowledge and skills to handle even complex legal issues. He helps his clients protect their assets, plan for the future and navigate the complex legal system.

Mr. Monceaux obtained his Juris Doctor degree from the University of North Texas at Dallas in 2019. Holding a certificate in financial planning from Southern Methodist University and a bachelor's degree in criminology from The University of Texas at Austin, he has a strong background in finance and law. He has extensive experience working with individuals, families and businesses in various legal matters.

One of the primary reasons why Mr. Monceaux stands out among his peers is his understanding of the needs and challenges of his clients, especially those who are facing long-term care planning issues. He knows how stressful and overwhelming it can be to deal with the legal aspects of aging, illness or death. Therefore, he offers compassionate and personalized advice on how to preserve their wealth, minimize their tax liability and ensure their wishes are respected.

Mr. Monceaux also assists his clients with probate and trust administration, guardianship and elder law matters and has a reputation for being responsive, reliable and professional. He takes the time to listen to his clients, understand their goals and explain to them their options.
